name: John Katko
bio: a Representative from New York; born in Camillus, Onondaga County, N.Y., November 9, 1962; graduated from Bishop Ludden High School, Syracuse, N.Y., 1980; B.A., Niagara University, Lewiston, N.Y., 1984; J.D., Syracuse University, Syracuse, N.Y., 1988; lawyer, private practice; staff, United States Securities and Exchange Commission, 1991-1995; staff, United States Justice Department, 1995-2014; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Fourteenth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2015-January 3, 2023); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress in 2022.
